summary: hdaprobe booted beside audiotest on an Intel HD Audio controller, with synthfs's audio node renamed so that the probe's open of /proc/audio fails, and `hdaprobe absent` booted with rach2.noaudio

argv: sh tests/proofs/guest.sh make rach2 check-libc utils musl-programs build/tests/system/harness && for profile in rach2-metal rach2-metal-disk os-real; do grep -Fqx 'file 0755 /bin/audiotest build/utils/audiotest' krffs/manifests/$profile.manifest || exit 1; done && sh tests/proofs/guest.sh copy ${WORK} rach2/kernel tests/musl/hdaprobe utils/audiotest && sh tests/proofs/guest.sh image ${WORK} 2 utils/audiotest=/bin/audiotest tests/musl/hdaprobe

status=0; /bin/sh tests/proofs/guest.sh boot ${WORK} --net hubport,id=net0,hubid=0 --qemu-arg=-cpu --qemu-arg=max --qemu-arg=-device --qemu-arg=intel-hda --qemu-arg=-device --qemu-arg=hda-duplex,audiodev=au0 --qemu-arg=-audiodev --qemu-arg=wav,id=au0,path=${WORK}/audio.wav --timeout 45 --steptmo 20 --ok 'HDAPROBE OK' --never 'HDAPROBE FAIL' --append 'rach2.rescue rach2.nonet' "expect=Type 'help'" 'send=exec /hdaprobe' 'expect=HDAPROBE' 'expect=returning to kernel shell' || status=1; /bin/sh tests/proofs/guest.sh boot ${WORK} --net hubport,id=net0,hubid=0 --qemu-arg=-cpu --qemu-arg=max --qemu-arg=-device --qemu-arg=intel-hda --qemu-arg=-device --qemu-arg=hda-duplex,audiodev=au0 --qemu-arg=-audiodev --qemu-arg=wav,id=au0,path=${WORK}/audio.wav --timeout 45 --steptmo 20 --ok 'HDAPROBE OK' --never 'HDAPROBE FAIL' --append 'rach2.rescue rach2.nonet rach2.noaudio' "expect=Type 'help'" 'send=exec /hdaprobe absent' 'expect=HDAPROBE' 'expect=returning to kernel shell' || status=1; exit $status
